## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, very handsome boy with broad shoulders and curly brown hair. He possesses a frank face with clear, straightforward, and roguish hazel eyes, alongside a mouth often twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

A clever, good-natured, and teasing young man, he possesses a kind, thoughtful, and self-sacrificing disposition, along with a strong desire to appease others when conflicts arise. He is deeply determined to do honest, meaningful work, aspiring to become a doctor in order to fight disease, pain, and ignorance. To achieve his ambitions, he is committed to earning his own way through college.

## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after spending three years in Alberta with his ill father and a summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). Upon his return to school, he inadvertently sparked a long-standing feud with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by teasingly calling her 'Carrots,' which led to her breaking a slate over his head and spurning his initial apology. Despite Anne's coldness, the two maintained a fierce academic rivalry throughout their remaining school years. Gilbert later rescued [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from a leaking flat on the pond and offered his friendship once more, though she rejected him again. Their fierce competition continued into town when they tied for first place on the island-wide Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) entrance examinations. While attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) together, Gilbert won the academic medal, but after graduation, he selflessly gave up his prospective position as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could remain near [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), finally prompting her to reconcile and accept him as a friend. Gilbert took a teaching job in [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) and co-founded the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Over the next two years, he regularly visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), collaborated with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on community projects, and discussed their shared ambitions and ideals. Their close dynamic gradually matured into a quiet romance, culminating in a intimate moment shared between them while locking up [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) following Miss Lavendar's garden wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. > “Not she,” said Gilbert emphatically. “I know Louisa Spencer well. She doesn’t ‘believe’ in Village Improvement Societies, but she does believe in dollars and cents. She’d be more likely to urge Judson on than to dissuade him.”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P46](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0046)

> “All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began their relationship as bitter enemies when Gilbert mocked her hair, causing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to hold a long-standing grudge and reject his initial apologies, including after he rescued her from a sinking boat. They maintained a intense academic rivalry throughout their school years, competing for top marks in their class. Over time, their hostility gave way to mutual respect and cooperation; by Volume 2, they put aside their old feud to become close friends and comrades, sharing their personal ambitions and collaborating on local projects like writing the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Notes.
